newsitem.title: CHINA: HK stocks expected to remain trapped in range.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks expected to remain trapped in range.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to remain around current levels on Tuesday, with little local or international news to provide direction, dealers said.
"It will probably be like yesterday," said Anthony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas. "People are waiting for the interim results to come out."
The Hang Seng Index inched up 8.47 points, or 0.05 percent, to 15,666.59 on Monday. Later, the Hang Seng London Reference Index slipped 14.23 points, or 0.09 percent, to 15,652.36.
"Everyone wants to know what HSBC will be doing next week," said Kent Rossiter at Nikko Securities.
Banking giant HSBC Holdings Plc is due to release its interim results next Monday.
Analysts forecast net profit growth of between six and 20 percent for the first six months of the year compared with interim net profit of HK$18.74 billion in 1996.
Mak said he expected HSBC to consolidate during Tuesday's session, but players would continue to take profit on "winners" like utilities and banks in favour of investing in property.
He added that second-tier red chips would be active.
